verdict.rationale: Plausible's source is public on GitHub (plausible/analytics), and it offers a self-hostable Community Edition. Community users describe it as FOSS that can be self-hosted and maintained independently, so the core of the story (readable source under an open license) is delivered. missing for 10: first-party evidence naming the specific license and its terms, and clarity on whether the cloud product's full source matches the Community Edition.
